name: GC induction (Gemcitabine plus CISplatin) for nasopharyngeal carcinoma

biomarkers.note: Nasopharyngeal-carcinoma-specific (site #37). EBV association is characteristic of NPC; gemcitabine/cisplatin induction is a category 1 option for EBV-associated disease. EBV DNA is used prognostically; it is not a dose gate.

lineOfTherapy: induction (neoadjuvant) doublet before concurrent chemoradiation in locoregionally advanced NPC; not line-scoped

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: locoregionally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma selected for GC induction before chemoradiation
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
eligibilityCriteria.locator: Nasopharyngeal systemic therapy: Cisplatin/Gemcitabine category 1 for EBV-associated disease (algorithm line 2057); Discussion line 9864 (gemcitabine/cisplatin induction); DeVita 12th ed. reference lines 60051 to 60053 (Zhang et al., N Engl J Med 2019, gemcitabine and cisplatin induction in NPC)

N Engl J Med 2019). The exact numeric dose and schedule are NOT present in the provided grounding sources, so dosePerUnit is VERIFY and days is empty pending verification. provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers
provenance.locator: Cisplatin/Gemcitabine induction, category 1 for EBV-associated NPC (algorithm line 2057; Discussion line 9864); per-drug numeric doses/days are NOT tabulated in the provided guideline pages

drugs.notes: CISplatin is part of the GC induction doublet for NPC (identity grounded). The exact numeric dose and schedule are NOT present in the provided grounding sources, so dosePerUnit is VERIFY and days is empty. ISMP tall-man. No lifetime cumulative cap for cisplatin; monitor nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, neuropathy; hydrate.

premedications.name: Hydration
premedications.notes: IV pre- and post-hydration for cisplatin.

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: high emetic risk (cisplatin). Confirm exact institutional/guideline tier.
Nephroprotection: IV hydration and electrolyte repletion with each cisplatin dose.

monitoring: CBC with differential before each dose - gemcitabine and cisplatin myelosuppression
Renal function and electrolytes before each cycle - cisplatin
Ototoxicity and peripheral neuropathy assessment - cisplatin

doseModificationRules.text: Review required; delay or reduce per counts. Physician decides.

doseModificationRules.condition: rising creatinine / falling GFR, ototoxicity, or grade 2+ neuropathy

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for GC induction (Gemcitabine plus CISplatin) in nasopharyngeal carcinoma. This regimen is nasopharyngeal-specific (site #37, EBV-associated) and does NOT serve the other head and neck subsites; salivary (#40) is not covered. The regimen IDENTITY (gemcitabine + cisplatin induction, category 1 for EBV-associated NPC) is grounded (NCCN 2.2026 algorithm line 2057, Discussion line 9864; DeVita 12th ed. reference lines 60051 to 60053 (Zhang et al., N Engl J Med 2019) and Chapter 24 line 59289). However, the exact per-drug doses, days, cycle length, and number of cycles are NOT present in the provided grounding sources, so all numeric dose fields, days, cycleLengthDays, and cycles are set to VERIFY and enumerated in verifyFields; the dosing basis (bsa, mg/m2) is retained per convention. ISMP tall-man applied. Cisplatin has NO lifetime cumulative cap; nephrotoxicity/ototoxicity/neuropathy monitoring plus hydration are specified. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
